observation.command:
cd /workspace && SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=$(grep '^SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2) && \
echo "--- Create school:"; docker compose exec -T backend wget -qO- --post-data='{"name":"Eckener-Schule Flensburg","slug":"eckener-schule"}' --header='x-super-admin-api-key: '"$SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY"' --header='Content-Type: application/json' http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/school/create-one-school 2>&1 | head -c 600; echo; \
echo "--- Create teacher:"; docker compose exec -T backend wget -qO- --post-data='{"schoolSlug":"eckener-schule","emailAddress":"admin@schule.de","role":"admin","firstName":"Vorname","lastName":"Nachname"}' --header='x-super-admin-api-key: '"$SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY"' --header='Content-Type: application/json' http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/teacher/create-one-teacher 2>&1 | head -c 600
